# DC segmenting Markdown to wiki renderer

## Problem and boundaries
Jira Data Center stores wiki markup while rebar authors Markdown. DC currently sends Markdown literally. Whole-body pandoc 3.6.1 was measured to escape prose/code arrows, erode table delimiters, and delete the <!-- rebar:reconciler-echo --> marker.

Add an unwired pure renderer. WikiTextCodec.fit_outbound retains 32,767-character truncation; normalize_outbound/to_wire remain string identity; decode_inbound retains string identity plus None-to-empty. OutboundFieldMapper, CREATE, normalize_rich_text, and live send paths stay unchanged. Story 3388 owns cutover/echo suppression/convergence. Story 5c0e owns timeout/process/GPL/SBOM hardening before cutover. Cloud uses ADF in its separate child.

Pandoc is chosen because its maintained CommonMark parser plus Jira writer produced 98.4% eligible-character coverage on the fixed corpus; surveyed pure-Python converters md-to-jira, mistune-jira, and md-jira lack equivalent maintained Jira-writer fidelity. Selective segmentation contains pandoc's measured damage. ADR 0083 governs imports. Add ADR 0095 plus docs/adr/.numbers/0095 for the decision, invariants, pin provenance, alternatives, supported-platform boundary, and deferred work.

## Corpus
Commit a deterministic scrubbed sample from scripts/build_dc_wiki_corpus.py: 29 code-arrow, 29 table, and 120 prose bodies, 178 total. The unavailable prior export and its old ratios are not acceptance evidence. The fixed-seed generator scrubs before writing, includes every available protected-phenomenon body plus prose, and keeps shards below 500 KB.

Records declare source text, protected excerpts, and eligible safe units independently of renderer output. Add tests/fixtures/dc_wiki_corpus to EXCLUDED_PREFIXES in scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py. Tests reject emails, tenant hostnames, and URLs.

Rendered-body ratio = bodies with at least one eligible safe unit changed by real pandoc / 178. Rendered-character ratio = sum of source characters in changed eligible safe units / sum of source characters in all eligible safe units across all bodies. Local measurement with the exact pin produced 0.927 and 0.984; tests require >=0.90 and >=0.95. Identity fallback fails because eligible outputs must differ.

## Renderer contract
Add adapters/jira_family/wiki_render.py with render_markdown_to_wiki(markdown: str) -> str.

Use a two-phase left-to-right lexer:
1. Lock complete {noformat} spans, backtick/tilde fenced blocks, and four-space-indented code blocks, including internal blank lines.
2. Split only intervening text into blank-line blocks plus list items; preserve separators/order.

Classify in order:
1. Locked blocks plus already-wiki units beginning h1.-h6., {code}, {noformat}, or {{ pass exactly.
2. ASCII table = >=2 pipe-bearing lines with a delimiter row of pipes/colons/hyphens/whitespace. Wrap exact bytes once in {noformat}.
3. HTML-dangerous = HTML comment or tag matching <[/!]?[A-Za-z][^>]*>; pass exactly.
4. Regex-dangerous = prose outside extracted code containing group opener (?; backslash class \b/\d/\s/\w; or bracket class followed by *, +, ?, or {n,m}; pass exactly.
5. Remaining headings, quotes, list items, and prose render via pypandoc commonmark -> jira with --wrap=none.

Code fragments are fenced blocks, four-space-indented blocks, and inline spans delimited by matching backtick runs. Extract/mask them before classifiers 3-4 and arrow substitution. In safe units use one regex pass ordered <!--, -->, <->, ->, <-, =>. Map <->/->/<-/=> to ↔/→/←/⇒. Both HTML delimiters always map to themselves, including standalone prose -->. Sequential replacement is forbidden. Inline code copies exactly.

After conversion, every extracted code fragment must appear byte-identically in order; otherwise return that source unit. Strip pandoc's content-free {anchor:} after headings. Already-wiki input stays exact, making repeated rendering deterministic.

Missing pypandoc returns the whole body and logs a structured warning without content. Conversion exception or preservation rejection returns that unit and logs a structured debug fallback class without content. Module state is immutable.

## Dependency and CI
Add wiki = ["pypandoc-binary==1.15"] and include wiki in dev. Register wiki in rebar._optional.EXTRAS with pypandoc probe; regenerate uv.lock. Add standalone wiki:wiki to .github/workflows/_optionality.yml, remove stale eval:eval, and change the joint lane from union:agents,eval,tracing to union:agents,tracing,wiki. Existing parity/removed-eval tests remain green.

An exact-pin local probe reports pypandoc 1.15, pandoc 3.6.1, and successful commonmark-to-jira output. A non-skipping test hard-imports pypandoc, requires version 3.6.1, and performs real conversion with an exact heading oracle, proving the jira writer without relying on get_pandoc_formats API shape. Wiki tests never use importorskip; dev installs wiki in every project pytest lane. The binary extra supports the project's Linux/macOS CI plus Windows wheels; core/BSD remains dependency-free with identity fallback. ADR 0095 records this boundary; story 5c0e owns pre-cutover portability hardening.

Changed paths: src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira_family/wiki_render.py; scripts/build_dc_wiki_corpus.py; tests/fixtures/dc_wiki_corpus/; tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_wiki_render.py; tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_wiki_render_corpus.py; pyproject.toml; uv.lock; src/rebar/_optional.py; .github/workflows/_optionality.yml; scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py; docs/adr/0095-dc-segmenting-wiki-renderer.md; docs/adr/.numbers/0095.

## Verification
Author the complete oracle RED-first; collect without skip/xfail. Run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`, `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck`, and `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make test`. Locally prove optional resolution with `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" uv sync --locked --extra wiki --extra agents --extra tracing`.

No contention test applies: stateless transform/local process; no store composition, retry/backoff, or cached state.

## Surface parity
CLI, MCP/API, public facade: out of scope; internal capability. Automated callers plus dual-direction: story 3388. Cloud: ADF child.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Safe units render through real pandoc in order; test_dc_segmenting_passthrough.
- [ ] Tables preserve exact bytes; test_dc_segmenting_passthrough.
- [ ] HTML/regex-dangerous units preserve exact bytes; test_dc_segmenting_passthrough.
- [ ] Specified single-pass arrows convert prose; test_arrow_substitution_cases.
- [ ] Code arrows remain exact; test_dc_arrow_substitution_spares_code.
- [ ] Prose plus code --> remain exact; test_arrow_substitution_cases.
- [ ] All 29 code-arrow fixtures retain protected excerpts; test_dc_corpus_no_code_arrow_is_ever_rewritten.
- [ ] All 29 table fixtures keep exact tables inside one noformat wrapper over five passes; test_dc_table_noformat_stable plus test_dc_corpus_tables_survive_verbatim.
- [ ] HTML comments survive exactly; test_dc_corpus_html_comments_survive.
- [ ] Existing wiki/noformat bodies stay exact over five passes; test_dc_already_wiki_body_passes_through plus test_dc_corpus_render_is_deterministic_across_passes.
- [ ] Missing pandoc returns exact body; test_dc_pandoc_absent_identity.
- [ ] Missing-pandoc warning contains no body; test_dc_pandoc_absent_identity.
- [ ] Conversion/preservation failure returns exact unit; test_dc_pandoc_failure_degrades_that_unit.
- [ ] Failure log names only fallback class; test_dc_pandoc_failure_degrades_that_unit.
- [ ] wiki locks pypandoc-binary 1.15; packaging test.
- [ ] wiki installs standalone; optionality lane.
- [ ] wiki jointly resolves without removed eval; local uv sync plus optionality lane.
- [ ] Real binary reports pandoc 3.6.1; test_dc_real_pandoc_version.
- [ ] Real conversion proves jira heading output; test_dc_real_pandoc_version.
- [ ] Rendered-body ratio >=0.90; test_dc_corpus_coverage.
- [ ] Rendered-character ratio >=0.95 over eligible source characters; test_dc_corpus_coverage.
- [ ] Cardinality = 29+29+120=178; test_corpus_cardinality_is_pinned.
- [ ] Fixtures contain no email, tenant hostname, or URL; test_corpus_carries_no_unscrubbed_secrets.
- [ ] Heading output contains no content-free anchor; test_dc_segmenting_passthrough.
- [ ] ADR 0095 marker passes scripts/check_adr_numbers.py.
- [ ] ADR 0095 contains Decision/Invariants/Dependency Pin/Alternatives/Deferred Boundaries sections; test_wiki_render.py.
- [ ] Existing WikiTextCodec tests stay unmodified; make test.
